messages:
Ava (partnerships): @here quick thread — Nimbus wants to finalize co-marketing assets for their marketplace tile + solution brief. Need: logos (SVG + PNG, color + mono), RTL one-pager variants, a signed customer quote from their CEO, and legal clearance for co-brand copy. Sharing Drive link: https://drive.redwood/partners/nimbus. Soft launch targeted Wed.
Diego (marketing): Thanks — can we get the exact signer name + preferred phrasing for the quote? Also need social tile crop variants (1:1, 16:9).
Omar (design): I can prepare logo lockups and RTL layout. Quick q: do we have Nimbus-approved Arabic translations or should I send the English layout to translation? :thinking_face:
Riya (legal): Please paste the quote draft here. If it contains a measurable claim, legal needs the measurement method/source and permission to publish. Also confirm trademark spacing in the lockup.
Ava (partnerships): Quote draft from Nimbus: "Redwood Inference reduced our inference spend 45% while improving tail latency." — CEO, Nimbus. They asked to use '45%' verbatim. Attaching screenshot in Drive.
Sam (product): Is that 45% across all production workloads or a specific benchmark? We should avoid absolute statements unless backed by an agreed study. Suggest: "up to 45%" unless they can confirm the scope. :grimacing:
Omar (design): Uploaded logo package to /drive/partners/nimbus/logos/v4
Assets:
```
Nimbus_logo_fullcolor.svg
Nimbus_logo_mono.svg
nimbus_logo_fullcolor_1x.png
nimbus_logo_fullcolor_2x.png
onepager_rtl_v1.pdf
social_tile_1x_1to1.png
```
:white_check_mark: I'll iterate RTL spacing and Arabic typography tomorrow.
assets-bot: File uploaded: nimbus_assets_v4.zip (1.2 MB) — uploaded by Omar on 2024-05-15.
Riya (legal): Reviewed the draft. Need confirmation from Nimbus on measurement methodology and explicit written permission to publish the 45% claim. Also request Nimbus' logo usage guidelines (clearspace, minimum size). Route final signed quote to legal@redwood for records.
Ava (partnerships): I'll ping Nimbus legal/Sophie and request the signed quote + measurement notes. ETA EOD Monday. If they confirm wording, marketing will finalize master tiles and marketplace copy. :rocket:
Diego (marketing): Once we have the signed quote and measurement note, I'll produce final marketplace tile variants and two copy versions (short + long). Will queue localization for RTL after confirmation. :+1:
Sophie (Nimbus): @Ava thanks — I'll confirm measurement details with our infra team and ask the CEO to sign the quote. Nimbus localization can provide Arabic translation for the one-pager. Expect docs by Monday.
Ava (partnerships): Great — marking this blocked on signed quote + measurement. Moving card to 'partner-review' on the board. Thanks everyone. :spiral_calendar:
